generation.mode: built-in imagegen edit with edit target and canon reference

lighting_isotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; water-mask pixels excluded and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lighting_isotropy.visual_check: No whole-cell cast-shadow field, sun angle, or time-of-day gradient is visible. Some basalt tops and upper tree facets remain brighter than adjacent faces, so the numeric aggregate pass does not prove the stricter same-value-on-every-side rule.

median_conifer_crown_final_scale.measurement: Median dark-green crown-component width across 64 isolated candidate components, scaled by 2560/1254. Edge-clipped and overlapping crowns make this a conservative mechanical estimate of visible full-crown width.

buildable_vs_steep_fraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land area
buildable_vs_steep_fraction.method: The coherent raised meadow table, station-ground strip, grassy ramps, and adjoining open moor count as buildable; exposed terrace and tor faces count as steep; dense tree stands, scree, and broken rock make up the remainder.

water_mask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
water_mask.derivation: Source-raster colour classification constrained to visually traced water country, connected growth through qualifying painted wet pixels, raster-derived row-by-row recovery of the narrow painted stream, morphological closure through wet margins and rock occlusions, component filtering, and enclosed-hole filling; not polyline geometry.

source_scale_gate_proxy.note: The repository Node runner is not exposed in this managed shell. This local reproduction uses the repository blue-fringe classifier at source radii scaled from the 2560 px canvas.

open_risks: The aggregate directional-key metric passes, but visible bright basalt tops and darker vertical faces remain; this does not satisfy the literal same-value-on-every-side lighting rule.

The conservative mechanical median crown estimate is 73.493 px / 3.528 m at final scale, below the required 84-147 px / 4-7 m range; several northern and eastern conifers are visibly smaller than the largest arriving crowns.
The treeless station-ground strip is present, but it narrows below three full crown widths in places and does not remain uniformly broad for most of the shelf.
Several terrace segments retain repeated upright column rhythms and brighter caps; owner visual review must decide whether they repeat the unnatural palisade defect.
The official Node authoring gates were not run because node.exe is not exposed in this managed shell; lighting and 6 px / 48 px water results are local source-scale reproductions.

Visual seam continuity, capital-shelf readability, exact water-mask judgment, geology naturalism, and terrain quality remain director and owner decisions; mechanical checks do not establish visual acceptance.
